Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material.why: Makes single-lane 224G high-speed copper communication cable, in scaled delivery as the main product of its high-speed cable business, and pushes it into AI computing and data centers (448G in customer validation); high-speed cable revenue rose 237.99% in 2025, so AI data-center copper interconnect build-out directly drives its communication cable segment.
Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material.evidence: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026): single-lane 224G high-speed communication cable keeps adding variants and remains in scaled delivery as the main product of the high-speed cable business; H1 2026 high-speed communication cable revenue RMB 6.31 hundred million, up 35.44%; the company is promoting high-speed cable applications in AI computing and data centers.

players.product: Single-lane 224G high-speed copper communication cable (twinax wire for DAC / server cable assemblies); single-lane 448G cable in customer validation and PCIe 7.0 high-speed cable in small-batch trial production

quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Communication cable segment (2025 annual report): 2025 revenue RMB 2,550,554,714.34, up 49.83% (30.18% of company revenue), of which high-speed communication cable revenue RMB 10.17 hundred million, up 237.99% - the report calls high-speed cable the key driver of the segment, on fast-growing demand from data centers, AI, high-performance computing and smart vehicles. quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (2025 annual report): in 2025 the company brought in multiple imported foamed core-wire extruders and expanded its Huizhou and Vietnam bases, sharply raising high-speed communication cable capacity; it says communication cable capacity will rise further as more equipment is delivered and new production bases start operating.

quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (2025 annual report): the company will focus strategically on core products for data centers, new-energy vehicles and robotics and drive synergy between its traditional businesses and new AI business; in communication cable it will concentrate on high-speed, automotive and industrial cable, raise technology investment and optimise the product structure to strengthen competitiveness and profitability; it plans to pursue overseas business through the H-share listing platform and its overseas production bases.
